title: 원본 SSA-MRN에 축척 혼합 학습만 적용(C0MS): W2 용량과 축척 혼합의 2×2 기여 분해
hypothesis: scale-mixed training helps only together with the W2 capacity: C0MS (original + mixing) does not improve over C0 on QB RR, while C2MS does (53); the 2x2 of W2 x mixing separates the two effects

arms.C0MS: original SSA-MRN K4, original + 2x coarser pairs (53 loss, coarse_weight 1); built exactly like 43 C0 of the same seed (identical initial weights)
arms.C0 (43): original SSA-MRN K4, original pairs only, QB seeds 42-44 from experiment 43 (not retrained)
arms.C2 (43): original + W2, original pairs only, QB seeds 42-44 from experiment 43 (not retrained)
arms.C2MS (53): original + W2, original + 2x coarser pairs, QB seeds 42-44 from experiment 53 (not retrained)

precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
loss: per-pixel MSE on the original batch + coarse_weight x per-pixel MSE on the same patches at the 2x coarser scale (53 loss; inputs normalized by 2047)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch0, earliest exact tie (43/53 rule); coarse validation is logged only
sensor_operators: 54 prepare.py SENSORS QB entry (MS GNyq 0.34/0.32/0.30/0.22, PAN 0.15, phase 2), the same coarse-pair construction as 53 prepare.py (checked before training)

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 (common/evaluation_protocol, QB); fixed before training
judgement.primary: QB: C0MS vs C0 (43) of the same seeds, v2.3 label on 3-seed means (effect of scale mixing without W2)
judgement.secondary: QB 2x2 of the same seeds: C2 vs C0 (W2 without mixing, 43), C2MS vs C2 (mixing with W2, 53), C2MS vs C0MS (W2 with mixing); interaction = (C2MS - C2) - (C0MS - C0) for RR, RR2, FR_WALD PSNR
judgement.qualitative: result images with common/result_images.py on QB scenes 0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 17 (C0 vs C0MS, seed 42)
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse-scale validation

limits: C0 and C2 are the 43 runs and C2MS the 53 runs (same code lineage, data, seeds and schedule); C0MS is trained here in a separate runtime
